name: National Digital Government Policy
whatItDoes: Sets principles and delivery standards for secure, inclusive and measurable digital public services.
intendedFor: All ministries, government agencies and public institutions delivering digital services.
mandate: Coordinate digital government implementation and improve public service access, interoperability and accountability.
textVersion: The National Digital Government Policy establishes the principles, responsibilities and delivery standards for secure, inclusive and measurable digital public services.

name: Public Finance Management Act
whatItDoes: Controls public revenue, expenditure, accounting, reporting, internal control and accountability.
intendedFor: Accounting officers, ministries, agencies, local authorities and public entities managing public funds.
mandate: Ensure lawful, transparent, disciplined and accountable public financial management.
textVersion: This Act provides the framework for public revenue, expenditure, accounting, reporting, internal control and accountability.

name: Public Procurement Regulations
whatItDoes: Prescribes procurement methods, competition safeguards, evaluation controls and award requirements.
intendedFor: Procuring entities, evaluation committees, suppliers and procurement regulators.
mandate: Promote fair competition, value for money, integrity and transparent public procurement.
textVersion: These Regulations prescribe procurement methods, competition safeguards, evaluation controls and contract award requirements.

name: Beneficiary Data Protection Guideline
whatItDoes: Explains safeguards for collecting, using, sharing and correcting beneficiary information.
intendedFor: Ministries, facilities, programme teams and service providers handling beneficiary data.
mandate: Protect personal data while enabling lawful, necessary and fair service delivery.
textVersion: This Guideline explains the minimum safeguards for collecting, using, sharing and correcting beneficiary information.

name: Environmental Management Act
whatItDoes: Establishes environmental assessment, permitting, protection and enforcement requirements.
intendedFor: Project sponsors, permitting authorities, contractors and institutions affecting the environment.
mandate: Prevent environmental harm and require lawful assessment, mitigation and accountability.
textVersion: The Act establishes environmental assessment, permitting, protection and enforcement requirements for public and private activities.

name: Public Procurement Act
whatItDoes: Establishes the legal framework for public procurement, competition, supplier participation, evaluation, award and contract oversight.
intendedFor: Procuring entities, procurement officers, evaluation committees, suppliers, contractors and oversight authorities.
mandate: Secure transparent, fair, competitive and value-for-money procurement while preventing conflicts, fraud and prohibited practices.
textVersion: The Public Procurement Act establishes the principles, institutions, procedures and controls governing the acquisition of works, goods and services using public funds.

intendedFor: Ministry of Lands, traditional authorities, local authorities, applicants, surveyors, planners, valuers and registries.
mandate: Administer land lawfully, transparently and with accountable approvals while protecting legitimate interests and public land value.

whatItDoes: Controls registration of land interests, searches, instruments, title records, transfers, mortgages, cautions and title-deed issuance.
intendedFor: Lands and Deeds Registry, conveyancers, surveyors, applicants, financial institutions and approved government officers.
mandate: Maintain authoritative, searchable and non-duplicative land records and issue title only after verified registration and approval.
